defaults.text: Fresh stories, useful ideas, thoughtful updates

css: .tb-h-magazine-masthead{position:relative;background:var(--tb-color-surface);color:var(--tb-color-text)}.tb-h-magazine-masthead__inner{max-width:var(--tb-h-magazine-masthead-width);margin:auto;padding:0 24px}.tb-h-magazine-masthead__brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--tb-color-secondary);text-decoration:none;font-weight:900}.tb-h-magazine-masthead__logo{width:38px;height:38px;object-fit:contain}.tb-h-magazine-masthead__brand-name{letter-spacing:-.025em}.tb-h-magazine-masthead__nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.tb-h-magazine-masthead__link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:9px 11px;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;font-weight:750}.tb-h-magazine-masthead__link:hover{color:var(--tb-color-primary)}.tb-h-magazine-masthead__parent{position:relative}.tb-h-magazine-masthead__submenu{position:absolute;z-index:20;top:100%;left:0;min-width:190px;padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--tb-color-border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--tb-color-surface);display:none;box-shadow:0 16px 38px color-mix(in srgb,var(--tb-color-secondary) 14%,transparent)}.tb-h-magazine-masthead__submenu .tb-h-magazine-masthead__link{display:flex}.tb-h-magazine-masthead__parent:hover>.tb-h-magazine-masthead__submenu,.tb-h-magazine-masthead__parent:focus-within>.tb-h-magazine-masthead__submenu{display:grid}.tb-h-magazine-masthead__chevron{font-size:10px;opacity:.65}.tb-h-magazine-masthead__note-row{padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--tb-color-border);text-align:center}.tb-h-magazine-masthead__note{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em}.tb-h-magazine-masthead__brand-row{padding:28px 0;display:flex;justify-content:center}.tb-h-magazine-masthead__brand-name{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:38px;letter-spacing:-.04em}.tb-h-magazine-masthead__logo{width:46px;height:46px}.tb-h-magazine-masthead__menu-row{padding:8px 0;border-top:3px double var(--tb-color-secondary);border-bottom:1px solid var(--tb-color-border);display:flex;justify-content:center}@media(max-width:820px){.tb-h-magazine-masthead__row,.tb-h-magazine-masthead__top,.tb-h-magazine-masthead__glass,.tb-h-magazine-masthead__frame,.tb-h-magazine-masthead__pill{flex-wrap:wrap;height:auto;padding-top:14px;padding-bottom:14px}.tb-h-magazine-masthead__nav{width:100%;order:5}.tb-h-magazine-masthead__submenu{position:static;box-shadow:none}}@media(max-width:560px){.tb-h-magazine-masthead__inner{padding-left:16px;padding-right:16px}.tb-h-magazine-masthead__row{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}.tb-h-magazine-masthead__search{width:100%!important}}
name: Magazine Masthead Header
description: A publication-style masthead with large centered brand and navigation rule.
